description: MTA Bus Stops is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This dataset contains point features for bus stops used on each route and direction within a bundle, including stop usage flags (revenue, timepoint, boarding, alighting, is in CBD) and basic route descriptors for mapping and stop-level analyses. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are coordinates, locations, express bus, mtabc, mta bus. The table has 24 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Transportation Authority. The portal shows 2026-09-06 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
